findings.title: 未确认子树已停止时仍清空 canonical active lease
findings.trigger: assert_native_closed rejects result with active_processes_last_observed=1, job_idle_confirmed=false, handles_closed=false; finally still calls close_canonical_lease when activated
findings.impact: 下一次activate只检查active UUID为空，可以在旧子树尚未证实停止时接纳另一trial
findings.requested: 只有实际primary exit、Job idle和句柄关闭等终结证据满足时才释放lease；未确认终结保留active UUID并记RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED/FAILED_CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED，Root处理后另行解除
findings.limitation: synthetic in-memory result and filesystem; not a claim actual native cleanup failed

findings.title: 检查后两次replace会覆盖并发canonical变更
findings.trigger: after final raw equality check, concurrent writer changes checkpoint while ownership replacement occurs
findings.actual: independent memory scheduler inserts revision350/new field; controller then writes revision342/old field
findings.impact: 静默丢弃其他已发生的canonical更新；两文件部分写入也不构成原子事务
findings.requested: 使用项目认可的独占canonical writer/lock与revision CAS，覆盖读取、最终检查和整个两文件更新；或撤出controller canonical写路径，由Root真实串行事务接口完成，部分结果必须原文记录并阻止继续
findings.limitation: deterministic in-memory schedule establishes code behavior under concurrency; not evidence of actual current canonical data loss

findings.title: pinned返回未经pin校验的第二遍raw
findings.trigger: file changes between pin(path) comparison and path.read_bytes returned to caller
findings.actual: pinned accepts reviewed hash but returns changed raw; module compiles returned raw
findings.impact: 真正加载的runner/observer或authority JSON字节可以与审查pin不一致
findings.requested: 一次读取raw，对这同一buffer检查完整pin并返回这同一buffer；使用已校验buffer解析/编译，保留canonical/reparse校验
findings.limitation: synthetic changing-reader counterexample; did not mutate any candidate source

findings.title: public_environment不是闭集且在审查前完整写入intent
findings.trigger: seed.public_environment contains an extra variable omitted by runner.cli_environment allowlist
findings.actual: basis excludes extra while controller serializes original whole dict and forwards it to CreateProcess environment
findings.impact: 未经basis绑定的变量被实际进程消费；若上游误传敏感变量，审查后再拒绝也不能撤回已写原文
findings.requested: 在任何intent写入/模块加载/子进程之前构造并验证精确公共环境闭集，写出、复核、观察和传入进程使用同一dictionary；不能只比较同一个engine.cli_environment两次
findings.limitation: used only synthetic dummy extra value; no real environment values or secrets read

findings.title: 同步before_resume期间没有独立绝对deadline终止器
findings.trigger: canonical filesystem/observer callback stalls after Job assignment
findings.actual: base's timeout check is after callback returns; controller deadline guard also runs after observer
findings.impact: 300秒deadline不能在回调未返回时使Job关闭，活性heartbeat线程可继续刷新，悬挂runner和lease超出边界
findings.requested: 由独立受控owner/watchdog按固定绝对deadline终止Job，覆盖assignment后的callback和运行阶段；终止原文与callback异常保留
findings.limitation: static ordering finding; no waiting/native process test performed

findings.title: 实际Job程序的argv/cwd和phase_worker字节未绑定审查范围
findings.trigger: 保持同一已审查run_owned函数帧、相同PID/handles/flags/deadline/environment，仅改真实frame的argv或cwd；或更换未纳入review tuple的phase_worker文件
findings.actual: 独立frame替身在foreign argv和foreign cwd下仍通过callback guard；Root controller仅临时记录phase_worker当前pin，CreateProcess参数仍为path，observer不验证此pin或命令
findings.impact: Job/PID/assignment事实正确也不足以证明启动的是本次被审查的SDK phase worker；可能对无关进程签发当前SDK admission review
findings.requested: source review加入phase_worker/Python/执行依赖closure，真实callback校验loc.argv/cwd为确切审查向量且进程创建前后的worker字节与固定pin匹配；将实际加载/执行buffer绑定不可变源，不能依赖后补self-reported intent
findings.limitation: 纯code-object/frame/locals替身验证分支，不伪称真实Windows callback；真实开发probe仍OPEN
